name: echo-brain
description: Tool-agnostic meeting-to-decision core with replaceable source, processor, and delivery adapters

scripts.test: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.product.config.ts
scripts.test:core: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/core
scripts.test:adapters: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/adapters
scripts.test:infrastructure: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/infrastructure
scripts.test:architecture: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/architecture
scripts.test:protocols: npm run build:workspaces && npm test --workspace @echo-brain/federation-protocol && npm test --workspace @echo-brain/organization-protocol && npm test --workspace @echo-brain/organization-api
scripts.test:local-org: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.product.config.ts tests/product/local-organization-coordinator.test.ts tests/product/http-organization-authority-client.test.ts tests/product/organization-state-store.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/integration
scripts.test:product: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.product.config.ts
scripts.test:federation: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.product.config.ts tests/product/federation
scripts.test:machine: npm run build:workspaces && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/machine && vitest run --config vitest.product.config.ts tests/product/adapter-factories.test.ts tests/product/decision-node-store.test.ts tests/product/sqlite-core-state.test.ts tests/product/product-database-migrations.test.ts tests/product/runtime-config.test.ts tests/product/runtime-isolation.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:boundary && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
